description: This is a Dart source file for a Flutter widget named SecondScreen. It implements a splash/routing screen that appears after the first run, determining which subsequent screen to navigate to based on user preferences. The widget displays a centered icon, app name, progress indicator, and footer text.

classes.name: SecondScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the splash screen and routes to the appropriate next screen based on stored preferences.

classes.name: _SecondScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the splash screen's behavior and navigation logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Overrides the StatefulWidget's initState to initiate routing after a delay.

methods.name: _routeAfterDelay
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for 1 second, checks preferences, and navigates to the next screen accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the splash screen, including icon, text, progress bar, and footer.
